hook.name: TweetPadV11UniversalHook
hook.description: A fee-custody hook that deducts a 1% creator fee, 0.5% protocol fee, and an optional 10% buy surcharge (active for 60 seconds after pool initialization) from each swap's unspecified output/input amount via afterSwap return delta, distributing accrued fees to a registered creator and a fixed protocol recipient.
